caveats: exact only over the explicit catalogue shortlist and retained nuisance-state bank
nuisance proposals and pruning are data-conditioned before exact grouped decoding
binary score frequencies are pooled over candidate rows and do not model rank or within-probe group dependence
below-threshold candidates are omitted only after proving a match loses to a miss
only exact refined acquisition basins receive a shared physical-exclusion group
nonidentical raw integer aliases lack authoritative physical exclusion groups and can inflate N
every observed scan probe may saturate the acquisition cap despite declared truncation zero
scheduled probe starts approximate candidate-specific local measurement epochs
observer coordinates are explicit but not capture-bound authority
